AlertDefinition.name: Cost Missing
AlertDefinition.Description: The @{alert.CostMissing} notifies the user with PRODUCTION responsibility if an item is missing a cost record.
AlertDefinition.Source: select item.itemKey, s, item, item.itemNumber, a.responsibility.responsibilityKey from Item item, PcmAlertSubscription s, ItemAssignment a join s.options o where a.item = item and a.effectiveFromDate <= trunc(sysdate) - to_number(:days) and a.responsibility = 'PRODUCTION' and s.user.userId = a.userId and s.alertType = 'CostMissing' and s.subscribeFlag = 1

Detail.Label: @{name} alert for @{item}
Detail.Body: A Cost Record for @{item} with responsibility @{responsibility} has not been created

Noop.Expression: not exists (select 1 from PcmCostRecord cr join cr.sourcingLane sl left outer join sl.supplier sup left outer join sl.toSite toSite where sl.item = item and cr.status = 'APPROVED' and (cr.effectiveFromDt <= trunc(sysdate)) and (cr.effectiveToDt is null or cr.effectiveToDt >= trunc(sysdate))

List.name: CostMissingToSite
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'ToSite' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or to_char(toSite.siteKey) = o.optionValue or toSite.parentSite = (select site from Site site where to_char(site.siteKey) = o.optionValue)))

MultiText.name: CostMissingSupplierName
MultiText.Expression: (exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Supplier' and lower(sup.businessEntityName) = lower(o.optionValue)) or not exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Supplier'))

List.name: CostMissingProductState
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'ProductState' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(sl.productState)))
